decisions.reason: Transactional email is strategically central to the firm's cloud messaging direction and likely remains worth keeping even if later website visibility fell or the offer was absorbed into a broader platform.

Document capture and recognition still fits compliant digital workflow demand from business and public-sector customers, though its lower later visibility suggests it is not as core as the flagship messaging products.

Email and fax conversion serves legacy and regulated communication processes that remain relevant in Germany, but its mature and transitional nature makes it notably more exposed to future portfolio rationalization.
As a narrow fax optimization feature with weak later visibility and limited strategic distinctiveness, it is the clearest candidate to be discontinued and its resources redirected.

Sandbox threat protection supports the firm's security-led value proposition in critical communications and remains commercially sensible even if it is increasingly bundled rather than marketed standalone.
